Computer Science

Computer science at Riverside is a three-year course that teaches you how computers work and how to make them do useful things, from the mathematics underneath to building large programs with other people.

In your first year you study programming, discrete mathematics and how computers are built, with small group tutorials every week.

Tuition fees for home students are set each year by the government; for 2027 entry they are expected to be the same as this year.

Three A-levels at grade A*AA, including Mathematics, or another qualification at the same level.

Apply through the national admissions service by 15 October; there is an admissions test in early November.

Can I study abroad?

Yes: you can spend your third year at one of our partner universities in Europe or North America.
